answer_4.quote: Subjective metrics assess the perceptual quality of synthesized speech based on human judgments... Mean Opinion Score (MOS) rates synthesized speech (e.g., naturalness) on a 1-5 scale. ... AB/ABX Tests present listeners with two samples (AB) by different methods or two plus a reference (ABX) to judge preference or closeness to the reference.
answer_4.guideline: Human raters evaluate synthesized speech using MOS (1-5 scale) for naturalness, as well as AB/ABX tests for preference and similarity.
